committee.sub: Morning brief · Wednesday 9 September 2026 · the committee’s read on the 7am numbers

items.text: Ad spend fell to $89.74 from $136.03 and clicks to 15 from 23, yet conversions stayed at zero. Only 3 clicks have landed since the 8 Sept restart, too few to judge the new structure yet.
Impression share sits at just 10% over 30 days, with rank lost at 77.1% against budget lost at 16.1%. The campaign is rank-limited, not budget-limited, so the budget conversation stays closed.

Sessions are down 30% (43 vs 61) and Direct fell to 22 from 37, but Direct still can't be trusted as demand since the internal traffic filter only went live 3 Sept and this window straddles that date. Organic Search, the only clean unpaid signal, ticked up to 5 from 3, still tiny. Search Console (data through 6 Sept, two days behind yesterday) shows 244 impressions for just 2 clicks, with most queries parked past position 40. AI Assistant traffic is still zero.

The homepage draws the most traffic (23 sessions) followed by /ai-automation-agency.html (12), but /simpro-xero-integration.html only pulled 6 sessions despite being the top search page with 124 impressions and position 18, suggesting a message match gap between what people search and what that page delivers.

actions.text: Add the missing logo and image assets and write keyword-matched RSA headlines for the ad groups now serving.
Fix the homepage form so kontrolTrackLead fires on the Formspree verdict (confirm-then-count), not before it.
Update RSA description D1, which still claims 13.3 hours of admin per week, to match the current site stats.
